summary: The performance slot installs cancellation handling before publishing its holder record, so early SIGINT and SIGTERM wait for watchdog cleanup instead of leaving a stale holder.

rules.detail: A published slot holder is cancellable even before the watchdog forks. Existing synchronous cleanup and signal exit statuses are preserved.

compatibility.detail: Command arguments and holder record format remain unchanged.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores the previous cancellation race; no application data recovery is needed.
